title: A finite-dimensional algebra over a field is Artinian
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $B$ a commutative ring together with a ring map $k\to B$ making $B$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space. Then $B$ is an Artinian ring: every descending chain of ideals $J_1\supseteq J_2\supseteq\cdots$ of $B$ is eventually constant.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00J6 (lemma-finite-dimensional-algebra, line 12714); proof: ideals of B are k-subspaces, so a descending chain has eventually constant dimension
